defect: DropNotNullChecks signals 'no check left' by returning null instead of an explicit TRUE expression.
Style: `== null` used instead of `is null` in the CASE optimization condition.
Style: mutable `test`/`expr` if/else assignment should be a tuple deconstruction, and the operand set declared after it.
The node-type dispatch chain in the null-propagation collector should be a single pattern-matching switch.
The collector's name (`NullPropagatedOperands`) does not read as an action; `DetectNullPropagatingNodes` is proposed.
Null-propagation detection is a local utility inside VisitCase with no extensibility point for provider-specific expression types.
AtTimeZone and Collate expressions propagate nullability but are not handled by the collector.
Whether AndAlso/OrElse should count as null-propagating operands.
The unary branch uses an allowlist (Not/Negate/Convert) that may omit other propagating unary operators; a denylist is proposed.
Null checks on non-nullable nodes could be elided by simplifying SqlExpressionFactory.IsNull/IsNotNull.
ExpressionType.Coalesce is treated as null-propagating by the binary branch, so DropNotNullChecks can remove a semantically required IS NOT NULL.
